claims.statement: GEMINI 4 ARGON - ANNOUNCED, NOT ADDED (playbook rule 9). Google's 2026-09-30 post: Argon is 'rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program'; wider availability for developers, enterprises and consumers 'as soon as possible', starting with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra; Google is in the U.S. government's voluntary pre-release access process. On 2026-10-07 the Gemini API models, pricing and changelog pages carry no Argon entry and no API model id; OpenRouter does not list it. Stated introductory price $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens (cached input 95% off), then $4 / $20 - a vendor statement, not a published rate. Output limit 1M tokens. Recheck 2026-10-14 (add to models.json and pricing only when the Gemini API pages list an id and rate).
